policy: Native source emitted; counted diagnostics have loss:true. Refused targets are counted separately, not as emitted loss.

profiles.subset: Graphviz DOT digraphs with explicit node/edge labels, quoted or bare IDs, comments, attribute lists, and directed node chains; no subgraphs, ports, HTML labels, or undirected graphs.

Mermaid 12.2.0 flowchart: bare/rectangular nodes, directed links and JSON-quoted YAML frontmatter titles; erDiagram: entities, fields, four cardinalities, relationship labels and JSON-quoted YAML frontmatter titles. Titles preserve plain Unicode, quotes, backslashes, hashes, tabs, and line feeds; carriage returns, ampersands, and angle brackets altered by strict rendering are refused. Labels are plain text/numeric-escaped; raw HTML, Markdown, named entities, and literal angle brackets are outside this profile.

Lini 1.1.0 flat block/entity cards with quoted labels and optional tooltip hints mapped to Visual node detail, quoted field display types, and directed links between cards or declared fields; undirected links refuse; field tooltips and layout/style declarations are retained with loss reports.
